title: Hypixel QoL
description: Hypixel QoL is a modpack built to enhance your experience offering a smoother and more intuitive gameplay for both new and experienced players. With performance optimizations, smart automations, an improved user interface, and much more
body:
Play smarter, grind faster, and enjoy Skyblock without the headaches.
Hypixel QoL - Better tools. Smoother gameplay. More fun.

**JVM Args SUGGESTION:** _-Xms8G -Xmx8G -Xss4M -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:+UseStringDeduplication -XX:+UseZGC_

Hypixel QoL is a lightweight yet powerful modpack designed to enhance your Hypixel Skyblock experience with smart Quality of Life features and helpful automations.
It brings together the best Skyblock tools to help you grind more efficiently, make better decisions, and remove annoying friction from the game.

## Key Features:

- Intelligent automations and real-time notifications (SkyHanni, DulkirMod, Odin)
- Advanced AH, Bazaar, and price tracking tools
- Clean, customizable HUD, scoreboard, and interface improvements
- Mining, farming, dungeon, and slayer QoL enhancements
- Profile and inventory management utilities
- Extreme performance optimization to keep high FPS
